# asserted at

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:assertedAt`](gmeow-assertedAt.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assertedAt>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

The instant an agent observed or asserted the annotated claim (e.g. an email Date header or a vCard REV) — a witness that the fact held at that instant. Distinct from validity ([`validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil) and from a source's carrier time.

## Structure

**Property shape:** annotation property; `?` -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:assertedAt`](gmeow-assertedAt.md) from `?` to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
